USE AND MANAGEMENT OF CERTAIN COMMON FACILITIES 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands, and accepts that certain Common Facilities, including but not limited to the gym (if any), swimming pool (if any), clubhouse (if any), and mini cinema (if any) provided within the Project, are intended for the shared enjoyment of all occupants. To help ensure a fair and pleasant experience, the Management Company shall implement reasonable usage guidelines for accessing such facilities. The Buyer further understands and agrees that, as some of these facilities may involve higher operational and maintenance costs, the Management Company may apply an access charge. The payment of CAM Charges shall not confer an automatic right to access such facilities. The Buyer also acknowledges that the Management Company may, from time to time, revise access procedures, usage guidelines, or charges as deemed appropriate to ensure effective management and an enjoyable environment for all occupants.
